name: SUNBEAM
confidence: read from a public-domain score, unchecked
reviewNotes: The melody line read from the Timeless Truths score of I’ll Be a Sunbeam (Jesus Wants Me for a Sunbeam) (https://library.timelesstruths.org/music/Ill_Be_a_Sunbeam/, Ill_Be_a_Sunbeam.xml, whose rights line reads “WORDS: Nellie Talbot, ca.1900. MUSIC: “Sunbeam”; Edwin O. Excell, 1900. Public Domain.”), verse and refrain; only the tune was taken, not the harmony. Its opening agrees with hymnary.org's incipit 56716 17565 43235 (https://hymnary.org/tune/sunbeam_excell); the leaps on “sun-beam, To shine” (F#4 D5 E4 D4 C5) are as the score prints them (checked against Timeless Truths' PDF). No hand fixes. Excell's dates (1851–1921) and the year 1900 are from the hymnary.org tune page.
